title: Transcendental-Free Rational Cauchy-Schwarz Decoding, Inverse-Polynomial Approximate NFCE PPAD-Completeness, Exponential Support-Reweighting Barriers, and Subquadratic-Slack Support Thresholds in Extensive-Form Games
abstract: Cheval, Horn, Paul, and Shirmohammadi (2026, arXiv:2611.34897v1) resolved a major open problem in algorithmic game theory by placing the computation of a normal-form correlated equilibrium (NFCE) in imperfect-information extensive-form games with perfect recall in PPAD for an arbitrary number of players (outputting a rational NFCE of support size at most K = 1 + sum_{i=1}^n d_i(d_i+1) <= 1 + N(N-1)), and by proving PPAD-completeness of exact two-player NFCE under the quadratic support bounds kappa_d = (d_1+1)(d_2+1) and kappa_+ = max{kappa_d, floor(|V|^2/36)}. We establish four sharp, transcendental-free structural refinements and impossibility barriers directly extending their framework, backed by 20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems (0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice, 0 warnings), 16 AST-audited zero-float SHA-256 certificates, and 56 adversarial tests: (1) Rational Cauchy-Schwarz decoding and 8x/64x gadget sharpening: replacing Shannon entropy, ln, D_KL, and Pinsker's inequality in Lemmas 18-19 with a purely algebraic two-bin Cauchy-Schwarz partition over Q proves TV(pi, x otimes y)^2 <= TV(mu, mu_1 otimes mu_2)^2 <= (1/4)(kappa/m^2 - 1) (asymptotically tight as m -> infinity for every fixed ratio kappa/m^2 in (1, 2)), which is sqrt(2)x sharper than Pinsker's sqrt((1/2) ln(kappa/m^2)) on (1, 3.51286...) and reduces Theorem 3's gadget parameter m by an exact factor of 8x (r^3 vs 8r^3; r^4 vs 8r^4), cutting |V| by asymptotically 8x and kappa_d by asymptotically 64x; (2) Robust inverse-polynomial delta-NFCE PPAD-completeness: extending Theorem 3 beyond exact (delta = 0) NFCE via reweighted Cauchy-Schwarz proves that any delta-NFCE on support <= kappa decodes to a weak zeta(kappa, m, delta)-Nash equilibrium with zeta = 2(m^2+1)*delta + (1/2)*sqrt(kappa/m^2 - (1 - 2*m^2*delta)^2), proving PPAD-completeness for delta-NFCE at delta = (2048*r^8)^(-1) = Theta(|V|^(-8/3)) under kappa_d and delta = (2048*r^10)^(-1) = Theta(|V|^(-5/2)) under kappa_+; (3) Sharpened Hadamard LP gap and exact exponential necessity family: replacing B = prod_{r in R} den(r) with the leaf-product lcm L_Gamma and keeping the simplex row unscaled halves Lemma 14's exponent to eta_sharp = (sqrt(K)*(K+1)^(K/2)*L_Gamma^K)^(-1), while an explicit {0,1}-payoff two-player bimatrix family (P_m, Q_m) in {0,1}^((2m+3) x (4m+2)) (B = L_Gamma = 1) with support |S_m| = 6m+2 achieves exact minimum regret t*(S_m) = (2^(m+5) - 14m - 30)^(-1) = 2^(-Omega(|S_m|)) > 0 certified by closed-form rational primal and Farkas-dual witnesses; and (4) Universal floor(|V|^2/4) totality, infinite kappa_V-failure, 1/36 b-ary optimality, and subquadratic-slack PPAD-completeness: we prove universal two-player totality at kappa_d <= floor((|V|-1)^2/4) <= floor(|V|^2/4), exhibit an infinite failure family Gamma_match(k) (|V| = 6m-5, m = 2^k) where kappa_V = floor(|V|^2/36) < m^2 is infeasible for all k >= 1, prove (b^2+b)/(b-1) >= 6 (equality iff b in {2,3}) makes 1/36 uniquely optimal over b-ary prefix-matching trees, and resolve Section 5's open problem for every subquadratic additive slack exponent gamma in (0, 2] by proving PPAD-completeness under kappa_d + floor(C*(d_1+d_2)^(2-gamma)) and max{kappa_d, floor(|V|^2/36 + C*|V|^(2-gamma))}, pinpointing gamma = 0 (constant multiplicative slack) as an exact decoding barrier.
